summary: BTQ Technologies Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1, a notice from Computershare regarding an Annual General and Special Meeting scheduled for August 12, 2026, with a record date of June 23, 2026. The notice indicates the meeting will be held in Vancouver, BC, and includes details on beneficial ownership determination and Notice and Access requirements. No special-situation event is described; the filing is a routine meeting notice disclosure required under the Securities Exchange Act. There are no deal terms, prices, or strategic changes mentioned.
